overview: This paper proposes an internal gap-based self-improvement framework for Unified MLLMs that leverages the stronger understanding branch to score and filter the weaker generation branch's outputs, constructing SFT/DPO training data to reduce the non-unification gap, enhanced by a curriculum learning strategy that progressively revisits previously discarded prompts.

modules.name: Prompt Loader and Stratifier
modules.description: Loads text prompts from multiple benchmarks (e.g., T2I-CompBench++, GenEval, Science-T2I) and stratifies them into difficulty levels (Easy, Medium, Hard) based on task attributes to ensure reliable estimation of the internal gap.

modules.name: MLLM Generation Candidate Sampler
modules.description: Interfaces with the MLLM's generation branch to produce multiple candidate images for a given text prompt, implementing the multi-candidate sampling strategy required for internal scoring and preference data construction.

modules.name: Internal Gap Scorer and Data Filter
modules.description: Utilizes the MLLM's understanding branch to score the generated candidate images against their original prompts. It selects the highest-scoring image as 'chosen' and lowest as 'rejected', and maintains a discard pool for prompts where no candidate aligns with the prompt.

modules.name: Self-Improvement Dataset Constructor
modules.description: Constructs PyTorch datasets from the filtered generation scores. It formats data for Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) using prompt-chosen image pairs, and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) using prompt-chosen-rejected triplets, handling image tokenization and attention masks.

modules.name: Unified MLLM Architecture Wrapper
modules.description: Wraps baseline models (e.g., Janus-Pro, Show-o) to expose unified interfaces for generation and understanding. It manages the shared LLM components, separate tokenizers/heads, and causal masking mechanisms for forward passes in both directions.

modules.name: SFT Training Loop
modules.description: Implements the training loop for Supervised Fine-Tuning on the generation branch, specifically updating only the shared LLM parameters. It handles loss computation for image token reconstruction and standard optimization steps.

modules.name: DPO Training Loop
modules.description: Implements the Direct Preference Optimization loop for the generation branch. It computes the DPO loss between chosen and rejected images, incorporating the negative log-likelihood (NLL) weighting on the preferred response to stabilize training while updating only the shared LLM.

modules.name: Curriculum Replay Scheduler
modules.description: Implements Algorithm 2 by dynamically expanding the training dataset. At specified epochs, it retrieves prompts from the discard pool, re-samples candidates using the current self-improved model, re-scores them, and adds successfully aligned pairs back into the training set.

modules.name: Non-Unification Metric Calculator
modules.description: Computes the core metric 'Non-unification score', defined as the proportion of cases where the understanding branch judges the generation branch's output as prompt-misaligned, directly quantifying the internal consistency gap.

modules.name: Weak Generation and Win Rate Evaluator
modules.description: Calculates the 'Weak Generation' rate using an external judge to confirm the gap's origin, and computes the 'Win Rate' for understanding capability by comparing the self-improved model's judgment alignment against an external oracle relative to the pre-trained model.

modules.name: Learning Dynamics and eNTK Analyzer
modules.description: Analyzes the co-improvement effect theoretically by computing proxies for the empirical Neural Tangent Kernel (eNTK). It calculates prompt/image similarities and log-probability dynamics between generation and understanding branches to validate aligned learning updates.

modules.name: Experiment Configuration Manager
modules.description: Manages YAML/JSON configurations for model selection, data paths, training hyperparameters, and curriculum learning triggers, ensuring reproducible and structured experiment tracking across different MLLM baselines.

modules.name: Distributed Training and Checkpoint Handler
modules.description: Handles multi-GPU distribution, gradient accumulation, and mixed-precision training for large MLLMs. It manages the saving and loading of model checkpoints across self-improvement iterations to allow resumption and evaluation at different training stages.
